connector.name: Obsidian Brain
connector.registryDescription: Obsidian MCP server: semantic search, knowledge graph, and vault editing. No plugin required.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package obsidian-brain. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sweir1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VAULT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).

env.name: DATA_DIR
env.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

env.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
env.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

env.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

env.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
env.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

env.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

env.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM
env.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

env.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
env.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
env.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL
env.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
env.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
env.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
env.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS
env.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
env.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
env.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG
env.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
env.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.
